sources.notes: Candidate source for full future-pick protections. Not automatically fetched in this workspace because direct scripted access returned a Cloudflare challenge.

sources.notes: Heuristic fallback layer for missing raw critical fields. Each fallback carries value, confidence, method, and notes so future sims can use a value without hiding uncertainty.

sources.notes: Trait-level monthly growth/regression model from age, minutes, role, staff, coach development context, current trait level, and health. Player personality is deferred.

sources.notes: Team-specific front-office archetype and competence/personality overrides for bounded AI GM decisions.

sources.notes: Trade valuation, team phase, practical legality, and bounded GM mistake/noise settings for v1 transaction AI.

sources.notes: Salary comp bands, practical contract guardrails, inferred player priorities, and bounded negotiation behavior for extensions and free agency.

sources.notes: Game-level player minutes, DNP status, and traditional box score stats used for availability-aware validation replay.

sources.notes: Provider-neutral moneyline, spread, and total cache from ESPN PickCenter when exposed in game summaries. Missing games are recorded explicitly and never inferred.

traits.label: Handle Under Pressure
traits.notes: Inferred from creation, turnover avoidance, pick-and-roll/ball-handler efficiency, usage, and touches.

traits.label: Passing Reads
traits.notes: Inferred from passer rating, assist creation, box creation, and existing basketball-IQ input.

traits.label: Stamina / Cardio
traits.notes: Inferred from projected minutes, prior minutes, and movement-heavy offensive role.

traits.label: Defensive Effort
traits.notes: Inferred from event creation, defensive impact, and defensive role.

traits.label: Scheme IQ
traits.notes: Inferred from existing basketball-IQ input, passing reads, defensive impact, and role responsibility.

traits.label: Rim Deterrence
